# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> Community-maintained open-source AI coding desktop. Desktop 5.0.0 targets public `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2`, reliable upgrades and one version across Windows, macOS and Linux. Release acceptance is in progress; native platform artifacts must all pass before publication.

## Canonical identity

- Product: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
- Version: 5.0.0 release candidate, not yet published
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 x64 stable; macOS Apple Silicon arm64 Preview; Linux x64 Preview
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Maintainer: ningbai牛逼
- Not an official DeepSeek product

## Local 5.0.0 candidate, not published

- This checkout targets Desktop 5.0.0 and official NPM Runtime 0.2.0-rc.2 with public dsh-web-all 0.4.4 and reviewed Desktop adapters. It is undergoing isolated acceptance, not a verified public release.
- bai authorization discovers and refreshes the actual model catalog, preferring available deepseek-flash. Authentication errors offer browser sign-in; there is no automatic payment or resend.
- Official builds include anonymous, opt-out product metrics; conversation content, prompts, code, paths and API keys are not collected.
- Large histories use authenticated fragmentation and complete reassembly without truncating messages or tool output. A logical message exceeding 32 MiB fails explicitly.
- Configuration preservation, Skin Center stylesheet ownership and 4.4.0 branding are included. Dock, third-party model integration and Skills remain available.
- Optional manual context summaries require user review; history is not uploaded automatically and no paid model is called automatically.
- Historical 4.0.0 screenshots and release links below are retained as version-labelled evidence. Confirm the actual GitHub Release before downloading; installer size and SHA-256 must come from that exact artifact.

## What is new in 4.0.0

- The manual terminal offers PowerShell, PowerShell 7, WSL, and CMD on Windows; Agent WSL is a separate opt-in tool with per-command approval by default.
- Agent Team, Browser Use, and Computer Use changes preflight the plugin environment and report restart or rollback progress.
- Automatic update checks defer while offline and back off after classified failures; manual checks remain available.
- Verified 4.x in-place upgrades retain the user's custom installation directory.

- Browser Use: official Playwright MCP by default, visible isolated sessions, system Chrome/Edge/Chromium discovery, approval-gated actions.
- Computer Use: bundled Cua Driver Native by default, external MCP fallback, permission discovery, observation/action separation, safe-mode recovery.
- Runtime: exact DSH 0.1.6 alpha.2 graph and source-verified dsh-web 0.3.23 cohort, with Desktop compatibility boundaries preserved.
- Migration: transactional 4.1 backup, fingerprint, idempotency, rollback, and long-context restoration.
- Extensions: informed risk-install path remains available after isolated preflight and rollback checks.
- Privacy: control telemetry is fixed-vocabulary only and excludes URLs, domains, page content, window names, screenshots, prompts, tool arguments, paths, and credentials.

## Release boundary

Windows is intentionally unsigned. macOS is unsigned and unnotarized. macOS and Linux are Preview platforms. One GitHub Release is created only after all three platform jobs succeed; GitHub Pages is deployed only after its download URLs are verified.
